description: Restricted file paths that the AI agent is allowed to modify - SECURITY GUARDRAIL

security_notes.purpose: Restrict agent modifications to core backend logic, shared schemas, and tests only
security_notes.rationale: Prevents accidental modification of build configs, frontend code, documentation, or agent infrastructure
security_notes.enforcement: File path validation occurs before any modifications are attempted

allowed_operations.server/: Backend business logic, API routes, services, middleware
allowed_operations.shared/: Database schemas, domain types, constants, validation
allowed_operations.tests/: Unit tests, integration tests, regression tests, test data

blocked_operations.client/: Frontend React code - requires manual review
blocked_operations.config/: Build and tooling configuration - affects entire project
